world_news_real.title: Russian strike on buses kills at least 30, say officials, as deadly attacks on Ukraine surge
world_news_real.description: Ukraine accused Russia of targeting two crowded vehicles in the front line city of Kramatorsk to kill as many civilians as possible.

world_news_real.title: Christa Pike now walking after failed US execution, lawyer tells BBC
world_news_real.description: A lawyer says the murderer of Colleen Slemmer is moving around her hospital room after surviving two lethal injections.

world_news_real.title: Venezuela's ex-leader Nicolás Maduro charged with conspiracy to commit torture
world_news_real.description: The new accusations relate to the alleged torture of US citizens held in Venezuela while Maduro was in power.

world_news_real.title: Residents airlifted to safety after flooding in central Chile
world_news_real.description: The Mapocho river has burst its banks after an unusually large amount of rain fell in recent days.

world_news_real.title: Italy approves elections overhaul as opposition accuse Meloni of 'scam'
world_news_real.description: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni says the move will deliver more stable government, but opposition parties say her aim is to stay in power.

world_news_real.title: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering, rights group says
world_news_real.description: More than 500 migrants have been expelled from the US to African countries, HRW says, citing US data.

world_news_real.title: Teacher who sexually abused pupil back in Indonesia jail after BBC investigation
world_news_real.description: Mochamad Subchi Azal Tsani had been secretly released on parole in 2025, after serving less than half his sentence.

world_news_real.title: Zambia signs US health deal after disputes over data-sharing
world_news_real.description: The US will provide $1.5bn (£1.1bn) under the deal that was negotiated after Trump cut USAID funding.

world_news_real.title: 'Every day there is killing': Palestinians in Gaza face Israeli strikes despite ceasefire as peace deal stalls
world_news_real.description: Many Palestinians are still living in cramped tent cities, with the US plan to end the war largely stalled.

world_news_real.title: Tanker hit by multiple projectiles in Gulf off Qatar, maritime agency says
world_news_real.description: Casualties have been reported on the vessel, identified by a maritime intelligence firm as the oil and chemical tanker, Acers.
